comparison.objective: Align an occluded service slider; the candidate adjusts and locks a stop screw.
comparison.physical_skill: Perception and constrained linear alignment with an obscured slider, not simultaneous concentric tool action.
comparison.success_condition: Slider reaches its aligned/service position; the indexed body does not provide a complete numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: Even without thresholds, an occluded linear-slider alignment is not a threaded setting-retention task.
